entries.def:
νόημα, -τος, τό
(νοέω) [in LXX: Sir.21.11, Bar.2.8, 3Ma.5.30 * ;] 
a thought, purpose, design: 2Co.2.11; 10.5; 11.3, Php.4.7. Meton., of the mind, 2Co.3.14; 4.4.†
(AS)

νόθος, -η, -ον 
[in LXX: Wis.4.3 * ;] 
a bastard, base born, i.e. born of a slave or concubine: Heb.12.8.†
(AS)

νομή, -ῆς, ἡ
(νέμω, to pasture), [in LXX chiefly for מִרְעֶה, also for נָוֶה, etc. ;] 
__1. a pasture, pasturage: figuratively, Jhn.10.9 
__2. a grazing, feeding; metaphorically, of a spreading sore, 2Ti.2.17 (Polyb.).†
(AS)

νομίζω
(νόμος), [in LXX: Wis.13.2; 17.3, Sir.29.4, 1-28; 2Ma.4.1-50, 4Ma.8.1-29 * ;] 
__1. to practise, hold by custom: Act.16.13 (Rec., but see infr.). 
__2. to deem, consider, suppose: Mat.5.17; 10.34; 20.10, Luk.2.44; 3.23, Act.7.25; 8.20; 14.19; 16.13, 27; 17.29; 21.29, 1Co.7.26; 7.36, 1Ti.6.5.†
SYN.: ἡγέομαι, q.v (AS)

νομικός, -ή, -όν
(νόμος), [in LXX: 4Ma.5.4 * ;] 
__1. relating to law: μάχαι, Tit.3.9. 
__2. learned in the law; as subst., ὁ ν. (EV, lawyer): Mat.22.35, Luk.10.25, Tit.3.13; pl., Luk.7.30; 11.45-46, 52; 14.3 (cf. MM, xvii).†
SYN.: γραμματεύς, q.v (AS)

νομίμως 
adv. (νόμιμος, conformable to law), [in LXX: 4Ma.6.18 * ;] 
rightly, lawfully: 1Ti.1.8, 2Ti.2.5.†
(AS)

νόμισμα, -τος, τό
(νομίζω), [in LXX: Est.8.36 (דָּת), Neh.7.71 R (דַּרְכְּמוֹן), 1Ma.15.6 * ;] 
__1. that which is established by usage, a custom. 
__2. The current coin of a state: Mat.22.19.†
(AS)

νομο-διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ 
a teacher of the law: Luk.5.17, Act.5.34, 1Ti.1.7 (NT and eccl. only; cf. νομοδείκτης, -διδάκτης, Plut.).†
SYN.: γραμματεύς, q.v (AS)

νομοθεσία, -ας, ἡ
(νόμος, τίθημι), [in LXX: 2Ma.6.23, 4Ma.5.35 4Mac.17.16 * ;] 
legislation, lawgiving: Rom.9.4.†
(AS)

νομοθετέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for יָרָה hi. ;] 
__1. intrans., to make laws; pass., to be furnished with laws: Heb.7.11. 
__2. Trans., to ordain by law, enact: pass., Heb.8.6.†
(AS)
